NSC Final Round, DETEC-CHEAT · Unity mobile game, 2022. Languages: Thai Native, English Fluent, Japanese Beginner. Workshops: LINE Developers University, Dialogflow + LINE Messaging API · 2025. Game Business Workshop, Gamification for business strategy · 2025.
